c.redflag.title: Warning signs — seek care without delay
c.redflag.intro: See a doctor promptly if you have any of the following:
c.redflag.i1: Bleeding from the back passage — especially the first time, heavy, non-stop, or with large clots
c.redflag.i2: Bleeding together with dizziness, weakness or feeling faint
c.redflag.i4: A high temperature with shivering and feeling generally very unwell
c.redflag.i5: Pus leaking from the anal area
c.redflag.i6: A lump that is growing quickly or changing
c.redflag.i7: Blood mixed in with stool, or a lasting change in your bowel habit
c.redflag.outro: These symptoms can have several causes. Only a doctor's examination can identify the cause and the right treatment. If needed, go to the nearest hospital emergency department.
c.disclaimer: The information on this page is for general patient education only. It is not a diagnosis and does not replace an in-person consultation. Only a qualified doctor can examine you, identify the cause of your symptoms, and recommend the right treatment for you.
